officialProductPage.evidence: Rossignol Germany labels the page NEUE KOLLEKTION FW2627, identifies product code RAPPX05000 and lists the no-bindings configuration at EUR 540. The product-dimensions table lists lengths 150/157/164/171/179 cm, 127/75/111 mm, radii 10/11/12/14/15 m, and Ski weight (kg/pair) values 1.5/1.6/1.6/1.7/1.8. The page says no bindings selected; it does not clarify why pair values are substantially lower than the retailer's per-pair table.

retailerWeightTable.productConfiguration: Forza 40° CA + XPRESS 11 GW B83 bundle
retailerWeightTable.evidence: Search-indexed retailer page identifies Rossignol Forza 40° CA + XPRESS 11 GW B83, year 2027, all five lengths, exact sidecut/radius table, and weight/pair values. Page does not expose the Rossignol article number and does not state whether listed pair weight includes the binding. It showed EUR 519 and unavailable at capture; price is not used to update the seed.

caveats: The exact-season Rossignol page labels its values kg/pair, but the amounts are about half the independent 2027 retailer's explicit pair weights.
The retailer's product name and season match, but the page does not show manufacturer article RAPPX05000 and does not state whether weights include bindings.
Rossignol 2025/26 catalogue records for the previous Forza 40 article RAOPX02 are not transferable to the 2026/27 article RAPPX05000.
weightConflict.decision: Seed records the retailer's explicit pair values with per-size notes and a visible weightBasis caveat. Do not interpret them as bare-ski or binding-inclusive weight until Rossignol or a matching exact-article source resolves the discrepancy.
